svg.text: Straiker on-prem: one customer, one AWS account, one region
Everything is created by one command (scripts/install-data-layer.sh). Pink = traffic from or to the internet, grey = inside the VPC.

g.text: one cluster · Karpenter node pools · namespace straiker
Models load from EFS / S3; 10 servers,
via EKS Pod Identity (no static keys)

svg.text: Not in the install: Argo CD, Grafana and OpenTelemetry (CloudWatch covers metrics, logs and alarms). Test installs swap the p4d pool for g5/g6/g6e nodes.
Details of every pod, model and connection: doc/architecture.md. Customer requirements: doc/customer-prerequisites-checklist.md.
